moments.author: Is Lebron A 76er Yet
moments.quote: Dormant account returns after 8 years: subtweets old post ‘No. He never will be now. Time to deactivate’ after LeBron signing with Sixers.
moments.why: A fan‐run account’s perfect eight‑year comebacks subtweet smashed records—54 M views, 1 M likes in hours.

moments.author: Mark Zuckerberg
moments.quote: Meta’s “The Future Is for Everyone” AI‑optimism video: “We’ve always bet on humanity” despite negative headlines.
moments.why: Zuckerberg’s upbeat AI campaign post is going viral as counter‑narrative to AI doom‑scrolling.

moments.author: Meta AI (announcement)
moments.quote: Meta AI now acts, not just thinks: plans, shopboards, training schedules—handles tasks for you.
moments.why: Meta’s announcement that AI now completes multistep tasks triggered buzz among productivity nerds.

moments.author: Mark Davis
moments.quote: “There was no way I was going to … play on artificial turf. Safety, grass stains—football deserves real grass.”
moments.why: Raiders owner’s old‑school defense of natural grass over turf is trending with players and fans.
